svg.text: One rule per octave, and whole-tone Set A is centred
directly ON it (y = 0), with Set B anchored one
whole-tone row above (y = −15pt) and no lower row at all.
The contour is stable by construction — but every Set A
glyph now knocks a hole in the rule it sits on, all Set B
pitches of an octave collapse onto one row, and the
raised outer row grazes the measure-numeral margin (2
lint violations on the canonical score).
